incomplete_block_rule: Any missing or invalid arm makes its block incomplete; no automatic retry, replacement, or extension is allowed.
multiplicity: One sole primary contrast. Secondary contrasts are descriptive and do not replace or modify the primary.

reporting: Report all numeric estimates, intervals, block outcomes, policy compliance, dose, and wall time without suppressing mixed results.
